Looking for haunted houses and haunted attractions in Northeastern PA? Find terrifying haunted houses, haunted hayrides, ghost tours and eerie Halloween experiences across NEPA.

Explore Haunted Houses & Halloween Attractions Across Northeastern PA

It’s time to get creepy, NEPA. Every fall, haunted attractions across the region open their doors to thrill-seekers ready for a night of chills. Behind the scenes, dedicated volunteers, actors, and artists work tirelessly to bring these frightful experiences to life. From elaborate costumes and bone-chilling makeup to sets that get more terrifying each year, the effort and creativity keep guests coming back—despite promising never to return.

Local haunted houses, ghost tours, and haunted hayrides deliver scares that range from spine-tingling to downright terrifying. Whether you’re braving the woods, wandering abandoned buildings, or following a lantern-lit guide through historic streets, these Halloween events capture the spirit of the season.

Get ready to scream, laugh, and maybe even jump out of your skin. Here’s your guide to the most popular haunted attractions and local haunted houses in Northeastern Pennsylvania this Halloween.

Haunted Houses & Haunted Attractions in NEPA

Dare to visit Circle of Screams in Dickson City and face your darkest fears! The haunted attraction has returned to the Circle Drive-In to spook guests with a haunted woods walk and abandoned house tour on Fridays through Sundays until November.

Devil's Last Laugh

September 25–November 1 | Lehighton, PA

Devil’s Last Laugh in Lehighton offers two frightening experiences from September 25 through November 1. Brave the Walcksville Asylum and its heart-pounding encounters before entering The Spread Scare Zone. This fractured, abandoned community hides new terrors around every corner. Food vendors and a fall bonfire round out the evening.

Learn More

Dunmore Cemetery Tour

October 4 & 11 | Dunmore, PA

The Dunmore Cemetery Tour at Dunmore Cemetery in Dunmore brings local history to life on October 4 & 11. The Dearly Departed Players share stories about those buried within the historic cemetery. Now in its 25th year, the seasonal walking tour explores fascinating tales connected to the Lackawanna Valley and Northeastern Pennsylvania.

Learn More

Fear at the Farm

October 2–November 1 | Bloomsburg, PA

Fear at the Farm at The Farm in Bloom in Bloomsburg delivers two frightening experiences from October 2 – November 1. Navigate a two-story walk-through haunted house filled with startling encounters. Then climb aboard the haunted hayride for more scares around the farm. Expect dim lighting, loud noises, strobe lights and interactive actors.

Learn More

Ghosts and Graveyards Tour

September 4–November 7 | Jim Thorpe, PA

Ghosts and Graveyards Tour at Jim Thorpe Trolley Co. in Jim Thorpe takes place from September 4 – November 7.  Explore the town’s eerie legends during a 75-minute ride. A live guide blends folklore and history while traveling through town. Hear haunting stories involving the Old Jail, mysterious mansions, local graveyards and restless spirits.

Learn More

Gravestone Manor

September 25–October 30 | Wilkes-Barre, PA

Gravestone Manor in Wilkes-Barre combines live theater and haunted-house thrills from September 25 – October 30. Rather than watching from the sidelines, audiences become part of the performance. Follow the cast through elaborate rooms and hallways filled with unexpected scares. The volunteer-run production benefits the United Way of Wyoming Valley.

Learn More

Halls of Horror

September 25–October 31 | Palmerton, PA

Halls of Horror in Palmerton offers an intense, interactive experience created for serious horror fans from September 25 – October 31. Small groups navigate the attraction while performers deliver physical interactions, mature content and strong language. For an added challenge, choose the optional Blood Experience, a messier encounter that takes the terror even further.

Learn More

Haunted Woods of Council Cup

October | Wapwallopen, PA

The Haunted Woods of Council Cup in Wapwallopen runs every Friday and Saturday night in October. Guests can expect haunted hayrides, updates to zombie paintball and eerie surprises throughout the woods at the Council Cup Campground. Each turn delivers new scares, making this a must-visit Halloween destination.

Learn More

Hell’s Nightmares Haunted Attractions

September 25–November 1 | Dallas, PA

Hell’s Nightmares Haunted Attractions at Irem Shrine Country Club in Dallas takes place from September 25 – November 1. Ride through frightening scenes designed to bring nightmares to life throughout the Halloween season. Suspenseful encounters and unexpected terrors challenge thrill-seekers to face whatever may be waiting ahead.

Learn More

Hellstead Manor

October | Hallstead, PA

Hellstead Manor in Hallstead takes place on Fridays and Saturdays throughout October. Attractions include the Swamp of Sorrows, The Cannibillies, and the Wretched Woods. With food trucks and firepits on-site, guests can unwind after surviving the scares.

Honesdale Ghost Tours

October 9 & 16 | Honesdale, PA

Honesdale Ghost Tours in Honesdale takes place on October 9 & 16. The tours lead visitors through historic streets filled with eerie stories from the community’s past. Guided walks explore haunted locations while revealing ghostly legends and unsettling local history. Tours depart every 15 minutes, creating an atmospheric way to experience downtown after nightfall.

Learn More

Gather your bravest friends for a walk through Horror Hall in Nanticoke! Step inside this legendary indoor haunt that has been terrifying visitors with its dark corridors, twisted characters, and spine-chilling surprises for over four decades.

Hotel of Horror and Altered Nightmares

September 25–November 1 | Saylorsburg, PA

Hotel of Horror in Saylorsburg features two distinct haunted experiences from September 25 – November 1. Explore five floors of transformed Victorian surroundings in the original Hotel of Horror. Then enter Altered Nightmares, a psychological journey inspired by the occult that plays with visitors’ perceptions of reality.

Learn More

Dare to uncover the dark past of Honesdale at Jail Tales! This spine-chilling tour through the Old Stone Jail explores eerie corridors and ghostly stories on October 10, 17, and 24.

Jim Thorpe Ghost Walks

September 4–November 14 | Jim Thorpe, PA

Jim Thorpe Ghost Walks at The Inn at Jim Thorpe in Jim Thorpe takes place from September 4 – November 14. The walks explore the Victorian town’s legends after dark. Follow a costumed, lantern-carrying storyteller on a one-mile outdoor journey. The hour-long experience blends ghostly tales with local history for an atmospheric, rather than frightening, evening adventure.

Learn More

Pardeesville Haunted Trails

October 15 – 17 | Pardeesville, PA

The Pardeesville Haunted Trail in Pardeesville runs from Thursday, October 15 through Saturday, October 17. This limited-time attraction sends guests into dark trails filled with lurking creatures and sudden frights. With outdoor thrills and classic scares, the Haunted Trails deliver a chilling Halloween adventure.

Learn More

Face your fears this Halloween season at Reaper’s Revenge in Scott Township! The haunted experience offers 90 minutes of pure terror across five spine-chilling attractions that are open from late September through early November. With Hollywood-level sets, relentless scares and nowhere to hide, this is a must-visit destination.

Reaper’s Revenge

Scranton After Dark

October 9, 16, 23 & 30 | Scranton, PA

Scranton After Dark in Scranton explores the city’s darker history on October 9, 16, 23 & 30. Follow a guide through Downtown Scranton while uncovering tales of mayhem, mysterious happenings and unsettling events. The Lackawanna Historical Society presents this seasonal experience on four Friday evenings.

Learn More

Dare to experience The Haunted at The Candle Shoppe of the Poconos in Swiftwater this spooky season! The guided history tour uncovers the eerie attic and mysterious laboratory of Dr. Fisher, where unusual primate research once took place. Check their website for tour dates, times and tickets.

Waldorf Estate of Fear

September 26–October 31 | Lehighton, PA

Waldorf Estate of Fear in Lehighton takes place from September 26 – October 31. The nationally-recognized destination immerses visitors in an intense night of horror. Frightening environments and unpredictable encounters make the sprawling attraction a Halloween destination for guests ready to test their courage.

Learn More

Haunted History Awaits at Eastern State Penitentiary

Embrace the spookiest time of year by touring Eastern State Penitentiary in Philadelphia. Explore haunted attractions and enjoy themed entertainment within the prison’s hauntingly beautiful walls during the Halloween Nights festival.

Read More

Face Your Fears at NEPA’s Haunted Attractions

From terrifying haunted houses and hayrides to ghost tours and eerie historic sites, Northeastern Pennsylvania offers plenty of Halloween thrills. Gather your bravest friends and explore these haunted attractions throughout the spooky season. Whether you prefer chilling stories or heart-pounding scares, there’s a fright waiting around every corner in NEPA.

It’s Spooky Season

Get in the Halloween spirit with even more haunted attractions and local haunted houses across Northeastern Pennsylvania. Explore ghost tours, haunted hayrides, and other seasonal events on NEPA’s most comprehensive local events calendar.
